patterns.reason: javac source/target still pinned to the source version of this jump; the run targets 17

rule_description: The javac task in build.xml pins source="11" and target="11". JDK 17 still accepts those values -- the Oracle migration guide lists 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8 and 7 as supported -source/-target values, and a probe build on jade-ant:17 compiled all 972 sources with zero errors at source/target 11. This rule is therefore NOT a build blocker and must not be described as one. What it fixes is that the artifact produced by a run whose target_version is 17 would otherwise still be a Java 11 artifact (class file major version 55), so the jump would be nominal. JEP 182 retires -source/-target values on a 'one plus three back' schedule, which is why 11 has a shelf life rather than a permanent home.
rule_name: javac source/target still pinned at 11 after the jump to 17
verification_hint: build.xml carries source="17" and target="17". 'ant clean lib' on jade-ant:17 exits 0 with BUILD SUCCESSFUL, and 'javap -v' on a class inside the produced jade.jar reports major version 61.
